page: Microsoft Azure M128-64ms is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8280L processor featuring 32 physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at a base clock of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration includes 105 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction support for AVX and AVX-512. The instance bundles 3892.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 60.81 GB of RAM per vCPU, accompanied by 4398 GB of local SSD storage. It features zero GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional uncached memory bandwidth, reaching 302.69 GB/sec for read operations and 155.48 GB/sec for write operations on 256 MB blocks, ranking within the top 25 percent. Multithreaded throughput aligns with mainstream enterprise hardware, as reflected by a multi-core stress-ng score of 43,757.8, a Geekbench multi-core score of 9,408.0, and 41.17 million Redis SET operations per second. However, single-core processing capabilities fall into lower performance tiers, showing a Geekbench single-core score of 897.0 and relatively slow single-threaded compression and LLM token generation rates.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the M128-64ms trades raw compute speed for extreme memory capacity and dedicated hardware isolation. This makes it an effective deployment platform for workloads where dataset residency in memory is vital, including large in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, massive Redis clusters, and large-scale relational database engines with extensive caching demands.
description: Microsoft Azure M128-64ms is a memory-optimized cloud server built for large-scale enterprise environments. Driven by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8280L processor, the system provides 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores, 105 MB of L3 cache, and support for AVX-512 extensions. Its hardware architecture includes 3892.0 GB of RAM, yielding roughly 60.81 GB of memory per core, coupled with 4398 GB of local SSD storage and zero GPU hardware. Benchmark data highlights top-tier uncached memory bandwidth exceeding 302 GB/sec for reads and 155 GB/sec for writes, balanced by average multi-threaded execution metrics such as 41.17 million Redis SET operations per second. Conversely, single-thread performance is modest. This profile is engineered for memory-intensive architectures, including enterprise in-memory databases and caching infrastructures.
